name: qa-module-campaign-portal-standalone
about: Standalone functional subset with only required modules. Native portal presence, locked refusal and actual mission picker entries; no imported boss/floor completion claim. Every declared success flag, missing flag and extra failure/crash is checked; original source assertions unchanged. With hoh1.content off (the default) the portal offers the HoH2 tower alone; the HoH1 version is fix-campaign-portal-version's (flag on). portal_offers_hoh1 (two missions) is no longer required: PreferHoH1 lists one.
